📖 How to use

  1. Add checklist tasks with optional due dates.
  2. Check tasks off as you complete them.
  3. Add budget items with estimated and actual costs.
  4. Watch the totals and remaining budget update.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do the checklist and budget work?

Use the Checklist tab to add tasks with due dates and check them off; use the Budget tab to add planned vs actual costs.

What do the budget stats show?

The budget tab shows planned total, actual spent, and remaining budget per item and overall.

Is everything saved?

Yes — both checklist and budget are stored in this browser's localStorage.

Can I back up my plan?

Click Export JSON to download both lists as a backup file.
